p: Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand: That is, the half tribe of Benjamin for the other half went after Jeroboam.
Israel: Meaning the ten tribes who rebelled.
built cities for defence in Judah: Or, repaired them and made them strong to be more able to resist Jeroboam.
hearts to seek the LORD God: Who were zealous of true religion and feared God.
walked in the way of David: As long as they feared God, and set forth his word, they prospered.
Abijah the son of Maachah the: Called also Abijam, who reigned three years, 1Ki 15:2.
desired many wives: He gave himself to have many wives.
